data.narrative:
Persona AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Nic Radford and Jerry Pratt that has raised $25M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of nine private peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and one public comparable (277810.KQ), though narrow peer filtering within identical stage and valuation tier yielded insufficient data for median-based triangulation.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable approach given data constraints. Using total raised as a proxy for current valuation ($25M) and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $62M. This reflects the magnitude of capital deployed and expected dilution progression through Series A.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $53M to $72M, with a central estimate of $62M. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this particular company's trajectory, the absence of granular comparable transaction data at identical stage and scale, and market conditions affecting Seed-stage pricing in capital-intensive hardware sectors. Any refinement would require either tighter peer selection within manufacturing robotics or additional datapoints on recent comparable financings at similar stages and capital deployment levels.
